TL;DR: The ChatGPT & Automation E-Degree is on sale for $14.97, (reg. $790), with 12 courses and more than 25 hours of AI-focused training.

AI is becoming part of more professional workflows, and understanding how to use it effectively can be a useful addition to your skill set. The ChatGPT & Automation E-Degree is currently $14.97 (reg. $790), giving you access to 12 courses and more than 25 hours of content.

The curriculum focuses on practical applications instead of just introducing AI concepts. One area covers customizing ChatGPT for different industries and professional needs, helping you get more tailored results from your conversations. Another explores AI and data visualization, including techniques for turning raw data into more compelling visual narratives.

There’s also a strong focus on automation, with lessons covering ways to streamline business processes and improve efficiency. The program explores more than 20 AI tools spanning marketing, business, and coding, along with real-world scenarios and applications.

The content is available 24/7, so you can work through the material around your existing schedule and revisit lessons as needed. Just note that the purchase is for the educational content; software is not included.

Get the ChatGPT & Automation E-Degree training while it’s on sale for $14.97 (reg. $790) through Sept. 10 at 11:59 p.m. PT.
